# Closest-results comparison

| Existing line | Shared ingredient | Different output | P5 output |
|---|---|---|---|
| Heat bath / overrelaxation | link dependence through staples | Markov update with correct equilibrium or faster mixing | invariant dispersion and lift cost |
| Cooling | local action reduction | deterministic smoother | exact residual geodesic-quadratic energy |
| Stout smearing / Wilson flow | gauge-covariant neighboring-link operation | differentiable smoothing trajectory | obstruction to an external-flat centered star motion |
| Riemannian center of mass | minimization of squared geodesic distances | existence/uniqueness and geometry | gauge-bitorsor interpretation and lattice residual energy |
| Discrete Hodge projection | covariance constrained to `im d1` | general decomposition | exact oriented six-star covariance spectrum |
| Constrained least squares | KKT/Schur complement | general optimizer | exact cubical minimum-spill spectrum and no-spill kernel |

The standalone case rests on the exact lattice-specific theorems and their
joint interpretation, not on any one classical ingredient.
